snippet.description:
Wishlist Highschool J on Steam:

A quiet transfer student. A normal school routine. Until the code starts breaking, and reality distorts. Highschool J is a psychological horror visual novel featuring glitch aesthetics, retro pixel art, and atmospheric storytelling.
